name: Better Posters (Local Quality Fix)
description: Fork of Better Posters that renders the quality badge locally from the item's real MediaStream data instead of btttr.cc's externally-sourced (often mismatched) badge.
overview: Better Posters, with an accurate locally-rendered quality badge

versions.changelog:
### Changed
- Badge visuals: gradient background, drop shadow, and tier-colored accent dot (violet/blue/slate/gray).

### Added
- Quality badge is now rendered locally from the item's real MediaStream data (resolution + HDR/DV/HLG) instead of btttr.cc's own externally-sourced badge.
